prompt: 使用 short-drama-agent，把 episodes/ep001.md 转换成 AI 视频制作方案，保存到 video/ep001/ai-production-plan.md。先提取角色图、场景图、物品图、线索图和关键帧资产，再生成连续性 Seedance 镜头任务卡。
expected: Reads the episode and relevant character context, writes a full production plan, creates asset-manifest/image-generation task expectations, then produces continuity-first 2-4 second video shot cards and copy-ready prompts.

prompt: 我粘贴一段含手机短信、新闻推送和监控时间码的短剧剧本，请用短剧agent生成 AI 视频分镜，要求屏幕文字不要交给视频模型生成。
expected: Produces a production plan that treats screen text/UI as post overlays, reserves blank screen areas, and keeps prop and clue states continuous.

prompt: 第一集 Seedance 粗剪不连贯。请用 short-drama-agent 检查 video/ep001/seedance-prompts.json 和 episodes/ep001.md，输出需要重做的连续性分镜方案。
expected: Compares the script and existing manifest, identifies continuity risks, prioritizes script causality, and marks shots/keyframes that need regeneration without blindly overwriting existing files.

prompt: 我给你一集剧本，请先抽取需要生成的角色、场景、物品、UI留白和关键帧资产，调用图像模型生成资产，验收后再调用视频模型逐镜生成。不要一次性生成整集。
expected: Uses explicit paid-generation and asset-approval checkpoints, creates asset and generation queues, then dry-runs or executes image generation before building one-by-one video generation tasks.

prompt: 参考专业短剧agent格式：本片段场景设定在: <location>L1</location>,<location>L2</location>。分镜1<duration-ms>6000</duration-ms>里使用<role>R5</role>、POV、28mm、内心想但没有张嘴。注意这些标签只是占位符，最终提示词要替换成对应场景、角色和时长，不要照抄标签。
expected: Resolves professional placeholder tags into concrete scene/role/duration content, uses broad cinematography language beyond the sample, preserves POV ownership and inner-thought/no-mouth rules, and connects the resolved prompt metadata to continuity-first video manifests.

prompt: 读取 Mx-Shell 的 ai-shortfilm-prompts 工作流，把 5 段式、真实摄影机镜头、呼吸感、同期声、瑕疵真实感、结尾留白和 IP 规避，优化进短剧agent的逐镜视频提示词里，但不要照抄他的原始提示词。
expected: Adds an Mx-Shell-style prompt polish layer that keeps short-drama continuity first while adding concrete theme tags, locked character/scene/material details, camera/lens anchors, subtle camera float or fixed-camera reason, production-audio policy, imperfection anchors, restrained endings, IP/filter warnings, and deterministic tests.
